title: The Hollow Gravity
author: Quentin Eastwick
blurb: August Reyes, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
